.....Respondents
 Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that in the
circumstances stated in the affidavit filed herein, the High Court may be
pleased to pass an Order, Direction or Writ and more particularly one in the
nature of Writ of mandamus declaring the action of the respondents in
proposing to take possession of land of the petitioners total admeasuring Acres
27-00 guntas in survey Nos.489 & 638 of Jallaram village, Kamanpur mandal,
Karimnagar district, without following due process of law either under the
provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 or the Right to Fair Compensation
and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 (Act 30 of 2013) and without paying compensation to the petitioners, as
illegal, high handed, arbitrary, and resulting in deprivation of rights of the
petitioners and also the principles of natural justice and consequently direct the
respondents not to dispossess the petitioners from said land without following
due process of law, in the interest of justice.

 Petition under Section 151 of C.P.C. Praying that in the circumstances
stated in the affidavit filed in the W.P., the High Court may be pleased to pass
an order directing the respondents No.2 to 4 not to dispossess the petitioners
from their land total admeasuring Acres 27-00 guntas in survey Nos.489 & 638
of Jallaram village, Kamanpur mandal, Karimnagar district, without following
 due process of law either under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894
or the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act 30 of 2013) and without paying
compensation to the petitioners, pending final disposal of Wp No.28597 of 2014
on the file of the High Court.

The petition coming on for hearing, upon perusing the Petition and the
affidavit filed herein and order of the High Court dated 26-09-2014 made herein
and upon hearing the arguments of Sri Shyam S. Agrawal, Advocate for the
Petitioners and the learned Govt. Pleader for Revenue (Telangana) for the
Respondents, the Court made the following
 Contd...2/P
Order:
Interim order granted earlier on 26-09-2014 shall stand extended by a further period of eight weeks.
Call after six weeks.
